method_note: Cues compile via ops/rule_trigger_compile.py _alternation: stopwords are stripped from the cue but the regex requires the remaining words ADJACENT (space -> \s+), so stopword-stripped bigrams such as 'party record' or 'behind scenes' cannot match natural prose ('party of record', 'behind the scenes') and are dead cues. trigger_rows() also emits every key of triggers.paths/commands as a row with no SURFACE_AT threshold applied.
